newsitem.title: USA: Schlumberger issues new smart card platform.
newsitem.headline: Schlumberger issues new smart card platform.

text.p: Schlumberger Electronic Transactions, a unit of Schlumberger Ltd, said Tuesday it is developing an open technology platform designed for secure, multiple application smart cards based on the Java Card application programming interface (API).
The company said it would make the platform available to Visa Member financial institutions and others as a basis for multiple-application smart cards.

Multiple application cards allow for grouping of two or more functions onto one card, so the card serves as several things at once, such as a combination credit card, ATM card and stored value "electronic purse."
The Java technology, announced last fall by Sun Microsystems Inc, is portable between compliant smart cards from different companies.
Schlumberger said the project is expected to be completed in early 1998.
In a separate announcement, Schlumberger Electronic said it introduced new contactless smart card products for the mass transportation sector.

One card is called Easypass, a low-cost proximity card that communicates with a terminal using radio frequency waves through an antenna. The second card is Easyflex, a combination contact-contactless smart card fully compatible with the Easypass card, the company said.

The cards allow mass transit operators to offer a range of products to their customers, including token cards for fares and cards that combine tokens with other applications such as a stored value or loyalty program.
